  • Class
    Description
    AdvancedTextEditor
    Espresso, the Advanced Text Editor application: the AdvancedTextEditorPanel editing surface presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
    AdvancedTextEditorPanel
    Espresso, the Advanced Text Editor: a production plain-text and source-code editor for the lg3d desktop, built as one plain-Swing panel that serves both desktops.
    Base64Tools
    The bundled "Base64 Tools" extension: encode / decode the selection as Base64, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Encoding category.
    BracketMatcher
    Pure bracket-matching for the caret highlighter: given a caret anchor, find the bracket it sits on (the character at the anchor, else the one just before it — the way every editor behaves right after you type) and return its partner's offset.
    BuiltinTextTools
    The bundled "Text Tools" extension: five whole-document / selection transforms registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI, proving the extension point works end to end (it is discovered through META-INF/services exactly like a third-party jar would be) while shipping genuinely useful utilities.
    CaseTools
    The bundled "Case Tools" extension: selection-scoped letter-case conversions registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI, complementing the whole-document BuiltinTextTools and CodeTools.
    CodeTools
    The bundled "Code Tools" extension: whole-document line operations registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI, the same way BuiltinTextTools is.
    CommentTools
    The bundled "Comment" extension (Espresso Phase 6): a language-aware line-comment toggle that reads the current file's comment syntax from the editor's own Languages catalogue and adds, removes or flips the marker on the selected lines (or the whole document when nothing is selected).
    EditorSettings
    The Advanced Text Editor's user preferences: font, indent, view toggles, theme and the recent-files list.
    EditorStatusBar
    The editor's status line: caret position, selection size, document size, file metadata (charset, line endings, language), font size and a transient message slot.
    EditorStore
    JSON persistence for the text editor: the extension enable/grant state.
    EditorTab
    One open document: the editor's per-tab bundle of model (DefaultStyledDocument + MergingUndoManager + file metadata) and view (JTextPane in a scroll pane with a LineNumberGutter row header).
    EditorTheme
    An immutable colour scheme for the editor: the chrome colours (background, text, caret, selection, gutter, current line, bracket match) plus one colour per TokenKind.
    ExtensionsCard
    The Extensions card.
    ExtensionsCard.ExtensionInfo
    One installed extension shown in the management list.
    ExtensionsCard.Host
    The panel-side callbacks for the extensions card.
    ExtensionsCard.PermissionInfo
    One permission an extension declares, with the user's grant state, shown as a checkbox in the management column.
    ExtensionsCard.Row
    One row in the actions list: either a non-selectable category header or a runnable action bound to actionIndex in the host's flat action list (headers carry -1).
    FindReplaceBar
    The editor's slide-down Find & Replace bar: two compact rows (find with navigation and match count; replace with Go-to-Line on the right) shown inside the panel rather than in a dialog, so it works identically in the 2D MDI host and inside the 3D desktop's offscreen SwingNode capture (a floating dialog would escape the captured quad; an inline bar cannot).
    FindReplaceBar.Host
    The panel-side callbacks the bar delegates to.
    FormatTools
    The bundled "Formatting Tools" extension: whitespace and line-ending clean-up for source files, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI and grouped under the Code category alongside CodeTools.
    GradleBuildTools
    The Gradle extension: drives the Gradle project that owns the current document and reports what really happened.
    HashTools
    The bundled "Hash Tools" extension: replace the selection with its lowercase hexadecimal MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 digest, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Encoding category.
    JavaCompletionTools
    The bundled "Java Completion" extension (Espresso Phase 4): dependency-free code completion for the current Java document.
    JavaDebugTools
    The bundled "Java Debugger" extension: a real single-file JDI debugger for the Java/Kotlin IDE (Espresso Phase 3), driven through the DEBUG capabilities of the Phase-0 chrome.
    JavaDevTools
    The bundled "Java/Kotlin Tools" extension: source-editing helpers registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI, exactly like BuiltinTextTools and CodeTools, and grouped under the Java/Kotlin category in the extension manager.
    JavaDiagnosticsTools
    The bundled "Java Diagnostics" extension: the live half of the Java/Kotlin IDE surface.
    JavaStructureTools
    The bundled "Java Structure" extension: the navigation and single-file refactoring half of the Java/Kotlin IDE surface (Espresso Phase 2).
    JsonTools
    The bundled "JSON Tools" extension: minify and pretty-print the whole JSON document with a lightweight character scanner, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Data category.
    JvmBuildTools
    The bundled "JVM Build Tools" extension: compiles, runs and debug-checks the current document with the real JDK toolchain, filed under the Java/Kotlin category next to JavaDevTools.
    Language
    An immutable, declarative definition of a source language for the syntax colouriser: the file-name extensions that select it, its reserved words, its comment syntax and a handful of mode flags.
    Languages
    The built-in language catalogue of the Advanced Text Editor: the immutable list of Language definitions and the extension-based lookup used to pick one when a file is opened.
    LineNumberGutter
    The line-number margin, installed as the row header of the editor's scroll pane so it tracks vertical scrolling (and word-wrapped line heights) for free.
    MandelaTools
    The bundled "Mandela" extension: Espresso's support for the desktop's own scripting language.
    MarkdownTools
    The bundled "Markdown Tools" extension: toggles inline Markdown emphasis on the selection (bold, italic, inline code) and bullet-list markers across the selected lines, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Markdown category.
    MavenBuildTools
    The Maven extension: runs the lifecycle goals of the Maven project that owns the current document.
    MergingUndoManager
    The editor's undo stack: a bounded UndoManager that merges a burst of single-character typing into one undo step, so Ctrl+Z removes the word you just typed rather than one letter at a time, while every other edit (paste, replace-all, delete, programmatic insert) stays atomic on its own.
    ProjectCard
    The Project card (Espresso "Projet" menu): create, open and manage project folders from inside the editor.
    ProjectCard.Host
    The panel-side callbacks for the project card.
    RecentCard
    The Recent Files card: the persisted list of recently opened paths, shown in-panel (a JList, never a popup menu, so it presents correctly inside the 3D desktop's offscreen capture).
    RecentCard.Host
    The panel-side callbacks for the recent-files card.
    SearchEngine
    The pure search-and-replace engine behind the editor's Find bar: literal or regular-expression matching, optional case sensitivity, forward/backward navigation with wrap-around, match counting and replace-one / replace-all.
    SearchEngine.Match
    One search hit: the [start, end) span of a match.
    SearchEngine.ReplaceResult
    The outcome of a replace-all: the new text and the replacement count.
    SettingsCard
    The Settings card: an in-panel form (shown through the editor's centre CardLayout) rather than a modal dialog, for the same reason as the find bar — a dialog would escape the 3D desktop's SwingNode capture.
    SettingsCard.Host
    The panel-side callbacks for OK / Cancel.
    SmartIndent
    Pure auto-indent logic: given the text of the line the caret is on, compute the indent the next line should get.
    SnippetsTools
    The bundled "Insert & Snippets" extension (Espresso Phase 6): one-tap insertion of the small boilerplate people constantly retype — a UUID, a timestamp in three flavours, an ISO date, a lorem-ipsum line and a random hex colour.
    SpringBootTools
    The bundled "Spring Boot Tools" extension: helpers for the configuration idioms a Spring Boot project lives on — converting between the flat, dot-notation application.properties and the nested application.yml, normalising property keys to Spring Boot's canonical kebab-case (relaxed binding), and listing every ${...} placeholder a document references — registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Spring category.
    SyntaxHighlighter
    The Advanced Text Editor's syntax colouriser: a small, dependency-free scanner that turns text into SyntaxHighlighter.Tokens according to a declarative Language, plus a batch applier that paints those tokens onto a StyledDocument with an EditorTheme's colours.
    SyntaxHighlighter.Token
    One lexed token: a [start, start + length) span classified as kind.
    TextEditorExtension
    The Text Editor extension SPI.
    TextFileIO
    The Advanced Text Editor's safe file layer.
    TextFileIO.LoadResult
    A loaded document: the normalised text (always '\n' endings), the detected charset, the file's line-ending convention to restore on save, and a non-null warning when the encoding was guessed.
    TextPositions
    Pure offset/line/column arithmetic on '\n'-normalised text, shared by the caret status line, Go-to-Line and the gutter.
    TextStatsTool
    The bundled "Document Stats" extension: a read-only companion that reports line, word and character counts to the editor status line.
    TodoScanTools
    The bundled "TODO & Task scan" extension (Espresso Phase 6): sweeps the current document for TODO / FIXME / NOTE / HACK comment markers, reports them as info-level diagnostics (gutter markers plus the Problems panel) and lets the user step between them with a "next" jump.
    TodoScanTools.Item
    One task marker found in the document.
    TokenKind
    The lexical classes the Advanced Text Editor's syntax colouriser distinguishes.
    ToolbarButtonConfig
    The user's ordered toolbar button selection: which commands (extension toolbar contributions, and any future built-in id) appear in the editor's user-configured toolbar section, and how each is drawn.
    ToolbarButtonConfig.DisplayMode
    How a configured toolbar button draws its contribution.
    ToolbarButtonConfig.Entry
    One ordered toolbar button: a stable contribution id and its display mode.
    WebTools
    The bundled "Web Tools" extension: conversion helpers for web/XML-oriented text, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI and grouped under the Web category.
